claims.claim_text: Beam is conducting the BEACON Phase 1/2 trial of risto-cel (BEAM-101 / ristoglogene autogetemcel) for severe sickle cell disease in approximately 50 adults and adolescents; adult and adolescent enrollment is complete; manufacturing of all doses completed as of December 2025; updated data was presented at ASH December 2025 from 31 patients with follow-up of 0.3-20.4 months.
claims.subject: Beam Therapeutics
claims.object_value: BEACON Phase 1/2 / risto-cel / sickle cell / ~50 enrollment complete
claims.source_quote: We are conducting a Phase 1/2 clinical trial designed to assess the safety and efficacy of risto-cel for the treatment of sickle cell disease, which we refer to as our BEACON trial. The BEACON trial includes approximately 50 adults and adolescents with severe sickle cell disease... The adult and adolescent enrollment for BEACON is complete, and manufacturing of all doses was completed as of December 2025... presented updated data from the BEACON trial at the American Society of Hematology 2025 Annual Meeting... preliminary data as of August 6, 2025, from 31 patients in the trial, with follow up ranging from 0.3 to 20.4 months.

claims.claim_text: FDA granted orphan drug designation and regenerative medicine advanced therapy (RMAT) designation to risto-cel, and risto-cel has been accepted into the FDA's Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls Development and Readiness pilot program. Beam expects to submit a BLA for risto-cel as early as year-end 2026.
claims.subject: risto-cel (BEAM-101)
claims.object_value: orphan drug + RMAT designation; BLA targeted year-end 2026
claims.source_quote: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration, or the FDA, has granted orphan drug designation and regenerative medicine advanced therapy designation to risto-cel. Risto-cel has also been accepted into the FDA s Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls Development and Readiness pilot program... We expect to submit a BLA for risto-cel as early as year-end 2026.

claims.claim_text: Beam is conducting a Phase 1/2 dose-exploration / dose-expansion clinical trial of BEAM-302 (LNP base-editing reagent) for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD / PiZZ E342K mutation). Beam has reached alignment with the FDA on a potential accelerated approval pathway based on AAT biomarkers evaluated over 12 months, and anticipates enrolling approximately 50 additional patients at the selected optimal biological dose.
claims.subject: BEAM-302
claims.object_value: Phase 1/2 AATD trial / FDA-aligned accelerated path / +50 patients planned
claims.source_quote: We are conducting a Phase 1/2 open label, dose exploration and dose expansion clinical trial of BEAM-302 for the treatment of AATD... We have reached alignment with the FDA on a potential accelerated approval pathway for BEAM-302 based on AAT biomarkers evaluated over 12 months. To support a future BLA submission, we anticipate enrolling approximately 50 additional patients to be treated with the selected optimal biological dose of BEAM-302 in an expansion of the ongoing Phase 1/2 clinical trial.

claims.claim_text: Beam is evaluating BEAM-301 (liver-targeting LNP base editor for the G6PC R83C mutation) in a Phase 1/2 open-label, multi-cohort, single-ascending dose clinical trial for glycogen storage disease type 1a (GSDIa) at select US sites; dosing complete in the first cohort and enrollment initiated in the second; initial data expected in 2026.
claims.subject: BEAM-301
claims.object_value: Phase 1/2 GSDIa trial; first cohort dosed; second cohort enrolling
claims.source_quote: We are conducting a Phase 1/2 clinical trial of BEAM-301 at a select number of sites in the United States. The trial is an open-label, multi-cohort, single-ascending dose evaluation of BEAM-301 for the treatment of GSDIa in patients with the R83C mutation... Dosing is complete in the first cohort, and enrollment has been initiated in the second cohort. We expect to report initial data from the trial in 2026.

claims.claim_text: Beam is conducting a Phase 1 healthy volunteer clinical trial of BEAM-103, an anti-CD117 monoclonal antibody enabling the ESCAPE platform; expects to complete dosing in the first half of 2026.
claims.subject: BEAM-103
claims.object_value: Phase 1 healthy volunteer; dosing complete H1 2026
claims.source_quote: We are conducting a Phase 1 healthy volunteer clinical trial of BEAM-103, an anti-CD117 monoclonal antibody that enables ESCAPE, and expect to complete dosing in the trial in the first half of 2026.

claims.claim_text: In December 2021, Beam entered into a four-year research collaboration agreement with Pfizer focused on in vivo base editing programs for three targets for rare genetic diseases of the liver, muscle and central nervous system. Revenue from license and collaboration agreements was $139.7M (2025), $63.5M (2024), $377.7M (2023).
claims.subject: Beam Therapeutics
claims.object_value: Pfizer 4-year in vivo base-editing collaboration (3 targets liver/muscle/CNS)
claims.source_quote: In December 2021, we entered into a four-year research collaboration agreement, or the Pfizer Agreement, with Pfizer Inc., or Pfizer, focused on in vivo base editing programs for three targets for rare genetic diseases of the liver, muscle and central nervous system... During the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, we recognized $139.7 million, $63.5 million and $377.7 million respectively, of revenue from our license and collaboration agreements.

claims.claim_text: Beam built and operates a 100,000 square foot cGMP manufacturing facility in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, leased from Alexandria Real Estate Equities through 2037, designed to support ex vivo cell therapy and in vivo non-viral delivery programs with capability to scale to commercial supply.
claims.subject: Beam Therapeutics
claims.object_value: 100,000 sq ft cGMP manufacturing facility, RTP NC
claims.source_quote: we entered into a lease agreement with Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. pursuant to which we built a 100,000 square foot manufacturing facility in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina intended to support a broad range of clinical programs, which lease expires in 2037... we have established a 100,000 square foot manufacturing facility in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina intended to support a broad range of clinical programs. The cGMP facility is designed to support manufacturing for our ex vivo cell therapy programs in hematology and in vivo non-viral delivery programs for liver and liver-mediated diseases, with the capability to scale-up to support potential commercial supply.

claims.claim_text: Beam's intellectual property estate is anchored in base-editing technology (CRISPR-derived single-base DNA edits) and a suite of LNP / delivery modalities; the company emphasizes a broad portfolio of patents covering base editors, delivery LNPs, and HSC programs.
claims.subject: Beam Therapeutics
claims.object_value: base editing + LNP delivery patent portfolio
claims.source_quote: Our proprietary base editors have two principal components: (i) a clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats, or CRISPR, protein, bound to a guide RNA... and (ii) a base editing enzyme, such as a deaminase... The intellectual property landscape around gene editing technology, including base editing and delivery technology, is highly dynamic...

claims.claim_text: On February 24, 2026 Beam entered a senior secured term loan facility of up to $500M with Sixth Street Lending Partners (initial draw $100M; SOFR+6.50%; matures 2033; first-priority security including IP; covenant to maintain liquidity of $40M-$125M tied to market cap below $1.75B). Net losses were $80.0M (2025), $376.7M (2024), $132.5M (2023); accumulated deficit $1.6B as of 12/31/2025.
claims.subject: Beam Therapeutics
claims.object_value: $500M Sixth Street secured term loan, SOFR+6.50%, matures Feb 2033, secured by IP
claims.source_quote: On February 24, 2026, or the Closing Date, we entered into a financing agreement... with... Sixth Street Lending Partners... The Financing Agreement provides for a senior secured term loan facility of up to $500 million... an initial draw of $100 million on the Closing Date... The Credit Facility matures on February 24, 2033... bears interest at an annual rate equal to the 3-month Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus 6.50%... Our net losses for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 were $80.0 million, $376.7 million and $132.5 million... As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $1.6 billion.
